transport: Two independently spawned Supabase CLI 2.115.0 db query processes using existing CLI authorization via the linked-project Management API; distinct concurrent PostgreSQL backends verified.
scope: Advisory transaction locks and read-only pg_locks/backend/timestamp queries only. All transactions rolled back; no schema, fixture, configuration or credential mutations. No migration or release.

phases.holderSql: BEGIN; SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock_shared(19092026,1); DO $$ BEGIN PERFORM pg_sleep(14); END $$; SELECT pg_backend_pid() AS holder_pid,clock_timestamp() AS holder_finished_at; ROLLBACK;
phases.contenderSql: BEGIN; DO $$ BEGIN IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_locks WHERE locktype='advisory' AND classid=19092026 AND objid=1 AND objsubid=2 AND mode='ShareLock' AND granted AND pid<>pg_backend_pid()) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'INCONCLUSIVE:no_overlapping_holder'; END IF; IF pg_try_advisory_xact_lock(19092026,1) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'FAILED:conflicting_lock_acquired'; END IF; END $$; SELECT pg_backend_pid() AS contender_pid,(SELECT pid FROM pg_locks WHERE locktype='advisory' AND classid=19092026 AND objid=1 AND objsubid=2 AND mode='ShareLock' AND granted AND pid<>pg_backend_pid() LIMIT 1) AS observed_holder_pid,clock_timestamp() AS observed_at,true AS conflicting_lock_blocked; ROLLBACK;
